name: Elu
summary: At Freewind Post, Elu tends the mounts and waits to begin wind rider training. He hopes to fly and asks Horde travelers to bring back wild wyvern eggs from nearby roosts.

sections.title: An Eager Apprentice
sections.body: At Freewind Post, Elu cares for the aerial mounts and dreams of flying. The young tauren hopes to join the master wind riders who patrol Kalimdor’s mesas. Before training begins, he must prove himself by bringing fresh wyvern stock to the roost. So he sends capable travelers to Highperch for intact eggs from the fierce wild wyverns nesting there.

faq.answer: Elu is a tauren apprentice wind rider at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He helps secure and raise new mounts for the Horde’s aerial network.

faq.q: Why does Elu need wyvern eggs?
faq.answer: Elu needs wyvern eggs to replenish the master wind riders’ stable. The young wyverns can be trained and bonded as mounts for the Horde.

faq.q: Where does Elu send adventurers to find eggs?
faq.answer: Elu sends travelers to Highperch, a mesa in western Thousand Needles where wild wyverns fiercely guard their nests.

angles.text: As a tauren, helping Elu supports a fellow tribesman learning to handle wyverns above your ancestral canyon lands.
As a Horde traveler, gathering wyvern eggs for Elu strengthens the Horde’s courier and transport network. It keeps remote outposts across Kalimdor connected by air.
